title: Apply expands the elicited public-hostname template per ingress rule and refuses on malformed templates and duplicate expansions
asA: shelf consumer applying edge-cloudflare-tunnel with two or more ingress rules
iWant: apply to expand <service>.<zone> per rule and refuse on malformed templates or duplicate expansions
soThat: a template that would silently collide two rules on the same hostname is caught at apply rather than at first inbound request

acceptanceCriteria.description: Given the default template <service>.<zone> and two ingress rules (service names "api" and "web") under the resolved zone "example.com", when apply runs, the applied sidecar records ingress rules with concrete hostnames "api.example.com" and "web.example.com"; every rule's hostname field matches ^[a-z0-9-]+(\.[a-z0-9-]+)+$.
acceptanceCriteria.given: the fixture apply harness with the default template and two ingress rules
acceptanceCriteria.when: apply runs and expands the template
acceptanceCriteria.then: the applied sidecar carries the two concrete hostnames matching the DNS-label regex

acceptanceCriteria.description: Given a template with an undefined placeholder (e.g. <unknown>), an unclosed brace (e.g. <service.<zone>), or a rendered value that violates DNS label rules (labels longer than 63 chars or characters outside [a-z0-9-]), when apply runs, apply refuses with code apply.hostname-template-malformed naming the offending template and no applied sidecar is written.
acceptanceCriteria.given: the fixture apply harness with one of the malformed templates
acceptanceCriteria.when: apply runs and expands the template
acceptanceCriteria.then: apply refuses with code apply.hostname-template-malformed and no applied sidecar is written

acceptanceCriteria.description: Given two ingress rules whose distinct service names expand under the elicited template to the same concrete hostname (for example a template with the <service> placeholder omitted or replaced by a constant), when apply runs, apply refuses with code apply.hostname-template-duplicate naming the collided hostname and both offending rule indices; no applied sidecar is written.
acceptanceCriteria.given: the fixture apply harness with two ingress rules expanding to the same hostname
acceptanceCriteria.when: apply runs and computes the expansion table
acceptanceCriteria.then: apply refuses with code apply.hostname-template-duplicate and no applied sidecar is written
